decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's service capabilities, had its own page in both 2018 and 2019, and supports machine sales at low cost, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing industry.
A fourth-axis accessory is a low-cost complement to the core milling machines, but it was only mentioned rather than featured, which points to modest results that the firm's slack can still carry.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business and was only briefly mentioned, so likely shortfalls against aspirations would prompt search for better uses of R&D resources.
The high-speed CNC milling line sits at the firm's core, has several models and its own page, and in a growing industry likely meets performance aspirations.
The automatic tool change system builds on the established offer, was presented on its own page, and adds value to the machine line, which suggests satisfactory results.
